Nothing needs to change in the database schema, `wrangler.toml` or `seed.sql`. I read the code and made no edits. The frontend has no shop UI. `shopTransaction()` in `game-api.service.ts` is never called. I recommend a dedicated inn endpoint instead of reusing `/api/shop/transaction`. That route is item-based and requires `itemId` and `quantity`. ## Worker | File | Change | |---|---| | `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add `export const INN_REST_COST = 10` next to `XP_THRESHOLDS` and the other constants. The value is a placeholder, so pick the real price. Add an `InnRestBody` interface (`sessionId`, `characterId`) next to `ShopTransactionBody` at line 159. | | `worker/src/services/character.ts` | Add `restAtInn(db, character)`. It makes one atomic `db.batch` update, `SET hp = max_hp, gold = gold - ?`. Don't use `updateCharacter()` here, because it is a single non-atomic statement. Return the refreshed character through `getCharacter()`. | | `worker/src/routes/inn.ts` (new) | Add `innRoutes` with `POST /rest`, modeled on `routes/levelup.ts`.
• Validate the body (400).
• `getCharacter` (404).
• Reject if `hp >= max_hp` with 400, so the player isn't charged for nothing.
• Reject if `gold < INN_REST_COST` with 400.
• Reject if the session is in combat: `loadSession(c.env.SESSION_KV, sessionId)` and check `session.inCombat`, as `routes/combat.ts:31` and `routes/action.ts:43` do. Fall back to `rebuildSession` if the session is missing.
• Insert a `'system'` row into `adventure_log`.
• Return `{ success, cost, updatedCharacter }`. | | `worker/src/index.ts` | Import `innRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/inn', innRoutes)` with the other routes at lines 41–48. CORS already allows POST. | An optional extra is a location check (`session.location`) so rest only works at an inn. ## Angular frontend | File | Change | |---|---| | `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add an `InnRestResponse` interface. Mirror `INN_REST_COST`, the same way `XP_THRESHOLDS` is mirrored at line 146. | | `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `restAtInn(sessionId, characterId)`, which POSTs to `${API_BASE}/api/inn/rest`. Put it in a new "Inn" section. | | `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add a `restLoading = signal(false)` and a `restAtInn()` method, modeled on `levelUp()`.
• On success, call `charSvc.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)`. This updates HP, gold and `hpPercent`.
• Call `pushEntry('system', …)`.
• On error, push the `err.error.error` message. | | `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn (10gp)" button inside `.sidebar-actions`, after the Inventory button at line 15.
